name: Napier Museum
summary: The Napier Museum in Thiruvananthapuram is run by Kerala's Department of Museums and Zoos, in a Gothic-style building in the museum and zoo gardens. Its collection, begun in 1857 under the Travancore rulers, includes bronzes, stone sculpture, wood and ivory carvings and coins.
highlights: Collection begun in 1857 under the Travancore kingdom
Around 550 exhibits: bronzes, stone sculpture, wood and ivory carvings
Coins from the Satavahana, Chera, Chola and Vijayanagara periods
The sword of Velu Thampi Dalawa, received in 2010
Run by the Department of Museums and Zoos, Government of Kerala
